name: ScriptBind_Mission_BossBattleMode
description: script binding Mission::BossBattleMode: sets charmgr(0x45B9E40)+0x26AA=1, resolves actor, fades out UI/bgm bits; entry for boss fight state

name: ScriptBind_Mission_BossBattleModeEnd
description: script binding Mission::BossBattleModeEnd: undoes BossBattleMode via 1C0D068/1C0CFB4/1C0CEEC/1C0E83C/9DECF8

name: ScriptBind_UI_ShowBossGauge
description: script binding UI::ShowBossGauge(actorId): if actor exists -> BossGaugeShow 1D115D4

name: BossGaugeSetup
description: fills up to 3 boss gauge rows (0x60 B each; screen layout 00_boss_gauge_hud / MENU_ID_BOSS_GAUGE_HUD)

name: MissionFlagSet
description: writes byte at [[mgr+8]+0x130+slot*0x400+flagIdx]; skips if def locked; calls change notify 702BBC/702974

name: MissionFlagGet
description: reads same byte array; 0xFF -> flag def default (def+0xC); slot from NG-level/difficulty (mgr+8 +0x10/+0x24)

name: MissionClearedGet
description: FNV-1a hash of id in table [db+8]+0x2E0, returns byte [entry+0x38+slot]

name: PlacementEnemyActivate
description: finds placement record (flag &1), actor via ActorFindById, sets actor+0xDA=1, +0xEE=0, runs spawn init 20A05C/2869A0 - this is how scripts spawn bosses

name: ScriptBind_Duel_GetBossPlacementID
description: boss placement id of current mission
